paul.name: Paul
paul.role: Writer who left Timothy at Ephesus to correct teachers
paul.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
paul.importance: Paul says he urged Timothy to stay at Ephesus. He calls himself a past blasphemer and persecutor who received mercy. He gives rules for prayer, overseers, widows, and the rich. He hopes to come to Timothy soon.
paul.connections: He calls Timothy his true child in faith. He names Hymenaeus and Alexander as men he handed over.

timothy.name: Timothy
timothy.role: Paul’s true child, told to stay at Ephesus
timothy.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
timothy.importance: Paul tells Timothy to stay at Ephesus. He is to stop certain men from teaching a different doctrine. Paul tells him not to let anyone despise his youth. He is to read, exhort, and teach. He is to guard what was entrusted to him.
timothy.connections: Paul calls him his true child in faith and his child Timothy.

jesus.name: Jesus Christ
jesus.role: Lord and one mediator between God and men
jesus.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jesus.importance: Paul says Christ Jesus came to save sinners, and Paul is chief of them. Paul says Jesus gave himself as a ransom for all. Paul charges Timothy to keep the commandment until Jesus appears.
jesus.connections: Paul calls him our hope and the man Christ Jesus. He says Jesus testified before Pontius Pilate.

word.languageNote: This is the dictionary form of the name “Christ.”

adam.name: Adam
adam.role: First man formed, named in a reason for teaching rules
adam.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
adam.importance: In chapter 2 Paul says he does not permit a woman to teach. He adds that she may not have authority over a man. As his reason, Paul says Adam was formed first. Paul also says Adam was not deceived. Paul does not name a local dispute.
adam.connections: Paul names him just before Eve. He says Adam was formed first.

eve.name: Eve
eve.role: First woman, named in a reason for teaching rules
eve.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
eve.importance: In chapter 2 Paul gives a reason for his rule about women teaching. He says Adam was formed first, then Eve. He says the woman was deceived and fell into disobedience. Paul does not name a local incident.
eve.connections: Paul names her just after Adam. He says she was formed after him and was deceived.
